The cancellation reason 'ordered by mistake' is explicitly acceptable per policy. The user was authenticated via email (message 4, result in message 6), and the order belongs to the authenticated user (message 8). policy_references: An order can only be cancelled if its status is 'pending'
The user needs to confirm the order id and the reason (either 'no longer needed' or 'ordered by mistake')
Before taking any action that updates the database (cancel, modify, return, exchange), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation
At the beginning of the conversation, you have to authenticate the user identity
